q: Consider an ideal fluid there must be laminar flow and no viscosity.
e: True. Consider an ideal fluid there must be laminar flow and no viscosity. Laminar flow moves in smooth layers with no mixing between neighbouring sheets.

q: The density of an ideal fluid is constantly changing.
e: False. An ideal fluid is incompressible, so its density stays constant. The error is the part about density ideal fluid constantly changing.

q: In a pipe, all the liquid that flow through section 1 flow through section 2.
e: True. In a pipe, all the liquid that flow through section 1 flow through section 2. Incompressible continuity: what enters one cross-section leaves the other.

q: The mass flowing in section 1 must be greater than the mass flowing in section 2.
e: False. Continuity keeps mass flow the same through every section of a single pipe. The error is the part about mass flowing section greater.

q: The equation $A_1 v_1 = A_2 v_2$ states that the liquid entering one end of the pipe leaves from the other end with a constant volume flow rate.
e: True. The equation A₁ v₁ = A₂ v₂ states that the liquid entering one end of the pipe leaves from the other end with a constant volume flow rate. A₁v₁ = A₂v₂ keeps volume flow rate Av constant along the pipe.

q: The larger the area of the pipe, the slower is the speed.
e: True. The larger the area of the pipe, the slower is the speed. Continuity: Av is constant, so a wide section runs slowly.

q: The smaller the area, the slower is the speed.
e: False. Continuity says smaller area means larger speed, A v = constant. The error is the part about smaller area slower speed.

q: The speed of water spraying from a hose increases by making the hose area smaller.
e: True. The speed of water spraying from a hose increases by making the hose area smaller. A smaller nozzle area raises v so that Av stays the same.

q: The speed of water spraying from a hose decreases by making the hose area smaller.
e: False. Narrowing the nozzle raises the exit speed, it does not lower it. The error is the part about speed water spraying hose decreases making.
